copy-paste fixed

Need portable code, not site asset paths?

The true copy-paste vault copies inline SVG, standalone HTML/CSS blocks, and a React icon registry. Use that route when the goal is to paste components into another project.

Open the true copy-paste vault
still included

This page remains the asset room.

The Dev Sauce page is still useful for browsing website assets, PNGs, and individual SVG files. The new vault is the no-path, paste-anywhere version.

What devs get.

Every icon is its own file, not a collage sheet. Use the SVG source for editable code, or use the PNG export when a project needs regular image assets.

How to use it.

Copy an icon SVG, copy the IMG tag, download the PNG, or paste one of the sx-* components. The CSS kit is intentionally isolated so it can ride inside other projects without hijacking the whole site.

Icon Arsenal

Individual assets, not a collage.

Use these as app buttons, feature cards, dashboards, docs, launchers, decks, dev portals, client pages, or product shells. Each card copies the raw SVG or a ready IMG tag.
